title: Mediterranean Tuna Capellini
description: Looking for a quick and easy midweek pasta dish? This Mediterranean tuna capellini is on the table in 15 minutes.
ingredients: 1 pinch crushed red pepper flakes, or to taste
1 (5 ounce) can tuna packed in oil
0.5 (15.5 ounce) can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Stir in capellini, bring back to a boil, and cook over medium heat until tender yet firm to the bite, 4 to 5 minutes.

Squeeze lemon juice into a large bowl, removing all the seeds. Pour in olive oil and mix to combine. Mix in Parmesan cheese, parsley, lemon zest, garlic, salt, and crushed red pepper until well combined. Add in tuna, flaking and separating larger pieces. Carefully fold in cannellini beans.
Drain capellini pasta and add to the tuna mixture. Toss to combine and serve immediately.
